sources.A_hf: config.json + generation_config.json + processor_config.json + chat_template.jinja; AutoModel registry: MODEL_FOR_IMAGE_TEXT_TO_TEXT_MAPPING_NAMES[glm5_next] = Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration (the only generative head); MODEL_MAPPING_NAMES[glm5_next] = Glm5NextModel (base, no head).

hardware.usable_figure_basis: registered figure for a CCL axis in play (28.6 GB/chip); not measured by this run
hardware.weight_budget_estimate: ~320B params; bf16 = ~640 GB total = ~20 GB/chip when TP/EP-sharded over 32 chips (embedding + lm_head replicated adds ~2.5 GB/chip) -> ~22.5 GB/chip < 28.6 GB/chip registered usable. Estimate from the config's parameter count, not measured.
hardware.host_ram_note: bf16 whole model (~640 GB) > host RAM (566 GB): neither the TT build nor the HF golden may load the whole model at once; both stream one decoder layer at a time from the FP8 checkpoint (dequantised exactly as HF's Fp8Dequantize does, verified bit-exact against HF's loader).

graduated_modules_verification.rule: graduated = component whose live _stubs/<name>.py equals a _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_{native,sharded} snapshot
graduated_modules_verification.checked: cmp of every live stub against its snapshot: all 23 SAME
graduated_modules_verification.note: bringup_status.json tags 9 of these REUSE / 1 ADAPT, yet every one of them has a graduated stub + snapshot and RUN_REPORT.md lists all 23 ON_DEVICE graduated; the prompt's PHASE-2 shard list also names REUSE-tagged ones (text_attention, text_linear_attention, text_m_l_p, vision_attention, vision_m_l_p). So all 23 are graduated work products and ALL 23 must be invoked.

scheme_evaluation_tp32.mesh_axis: every sharded stub derives cluster_axis = the single mesh axis with size > 1 = axis 1 (the 32 TP columns); all agree
scheme_evaluation_tp32.collective: all_gather(dim=1, cluster_axis=1, Linear) + on-device sum (ttnn.all_reduce deadlocks on the 1x32 line per the stubs' notes); gathers padded to >= 64 tiles/chip

checks.text_linear_attention (KDA, head-paralle: linear num_heads 64 % 32 == 0 -> 2 heads/chip; recurrence never split in time. OK
checks.vision_attention (head-parallel): vision num_heads 16 < 32 -> each head computed by r = 32/16 = 2 chips, o-proj rows scaled 1/r (power of two, exact). OK
checks.batch_axis: B is a separate leading/row axis, never sharded; TP split unchanged

task_heads.reference: model.generate() semantics: greedy-or-sampled autoregressive decode until a generation_config.eos_token_id ({154820,154827,154829}); golden built with HF's own module classes (Glm5NextVisionModel, Glm5NextTextDecoderLayer x45, embed_tokens, hc_head, norm, lm_head) streamed one layer at a time because the whole bf16 model exceeds host RAM; batch rows = identical example input, per-row seed 0..31 under generation_config temperature/top_p (Gumbel-max with seeded noise so both sides draw the same sample)
task_heads.input: HF processor (Glm5NextProcessor.apply_chat_template) over the published docstring example of Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.forward: image https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/pipeline-cat-chonk.jpeg + text 'Describe the image.'

vision_encode.vision_model: top-level vision stack object (TtVisionModel) owning the stages below
vision_encode.vision_block: x24, each = r_m_s_norm(norm1) -> vision_attention -> residual -> r_m_s_norm(norm2) -> vision_m_l_p -> residual
vision_encode.vision_patch_merger: after downsample: image embeddings [R,4096] scattered into the image-token rows of inputs_embeds (on device)

prefill/decode (text).text_model: top-level text stack object (TtTextModel) owning 45 text_decoder_layer + hc_head + final norm
prefill/decode (text).text_decoder_layer: x45 (34 KDA + 11 DSA; 3 dense MLP + 42 MoE)
prefill/decode (text).text_hyper_connection: attn_hc and ffn_hc of every layer (pre/post/comb + stream collapse)
prefill/decode (text).text_unweighted_r_m_s_norm: the hyper-connection input norm of every attn_hc/ffn_hc
prefill/decode (text).text_r_m_s_norm: input_layernorm / post_attention_layernorm of every layer and the final model norm
prefill/decode (text).text_forget_gate: KDA forget gate g of every KDA layer
prefill/decode (text).text_r_m_s_norm_gated: KDA o_norm (gated by g_b(g_a(x))) of every KDA layer
prefill/decode (text).text_indexer: DSA top-k pool selection of every DSA layer; its indices are turned into the attention mask on device
prefill/decode (text).text_m_l_p: dense MLP of layers 0-2 and the shared expert of every MoE layer
prefill/decode (text).text_mo_e: mlp of the 42 sparse layers = text_topk_router -> text_experts (+ text_m_l_p shared)
prefill/decode (text).text_topk_router: router of every MoE layer (indices, weights)
prefill/decode (text).text_experts: routed experts of every MoE layer, fed the router's indices/weights
prefill/decode (text).text_hyper_head: final stream collapse before the final norm

stub_routing.lm_head + sampling: lm_head (replicated bf16 linear) + on-device argmax/sample -> next token id; next-step embedding gathered on device (ttnn.embedding)

pass_definition.gate1: every routed stub's forward is pure ttnn (no torch compute in the call path); the 17 sharded stubs keep ShardTensorToMesh + all_gather collectives (not rewritten to replication)
pass_definition.gate2: every one of the 23 graduated stub classes records >= 1 invocation during the real generate run (counters wrapped around the stub __call__s inside the forward path); missing any -> FAIL
pass_definition.gate3: per-row PCC of TT vs HF logits over the row's WHOLE generated output (all decode steps concatenated) >= 0.99, min over the 32 rows reported as 'e2e PCC='; every generated token equals the reference's own choice (teacher-forced, same seeded noise, HF TopPLogitsWarper) except choices the bf16 reference cannot resolve (its margin <= 4 bf16 ULPs of its top score), capped at 5%
pass_definition.validation_metric: whole-output logits PCC per row; per-step PCC mean/p05/min printed; image embeddings and prefill hidden PCC >= 0.995 (min row) with norm ratio within 0.5%
pass_definition.behavioral_proof: decoded text of the TT generation printed beside the HF golden text; run stops on an eos_token_id, not on the safety cap
pass_definition.decode_horizon: stop on generation_config.eos_token_id for both TT and HF; safety cap from the pipeline capacity (asserted not hit unless TT_PERF_OSL_TOKENS is set)
pass_definition.why_not_min_step_pcc: measured on the B=1 384-token run: vs the exact fp32 HF math, TT per-step PCC mean 0.9980 / min 0.9625 while the HF bf16 golden itself is mean 0.9964 / min 0.9286, and HF-bf16 argmax disagrees with fp32 on 11/384 tokens (TT: 9/384); a per-step min >= 0.99 or exact token equality with a bf16 golden is a criterion the reference fails against its own fp32 math

self_validation_plan: 1. loader: streamed per-layer state dicts == HF from_pretrained (truncated) state dicts, bitwise, for layers 0-3, vision blocks 0-1, embed/lm_head/norm
2. one-layer device check per layer kind (KDA+dense, DSA+MoE) vs HF layer in fp32: PCC >= 0.99
3. full-depth prefill: TT logits vs HF golden logits PCC, hidden state PCC/norm ratio
4. decode with resident KDA recurrent/conv state + DSA KV cache vs HF golden (same stop rule)
decode_horizon_note: eos from generation_config; safety cap = capacity index_topk (2048) - prompt; test asserts the cap was not hit
